population: all dated LDAP roster members within the intersection of complete source-file calendar-day ranges
primary_labels: actor, channel, original ID and timestamp matched official observables; day positive only for declared incident actor
secondary_labels: declared actor master incident interval, with actual modeled activity on the day
features: per-channel counts and unusual-hour counts; earlier personal and peer count deviations; workstation novelty from earlier activity
cold_start: keep days; use previous-day population/eligible peer reference, explicitly marked limited until 14 prior calendar days
combination: 0.6 validation-ECDF rule deviation + 0.4 validation-ECDF IF anomaly
workload: validation-frozen threshold for 1 alert per 100 user-days; deterministic SHA256 user-day tie break independent of labels
holdout_warning: r4.2 is development evidence. No independent efficacy or production accuracy claim. Original v1 0 TP retained.
